prompt: On what date did the world record 100 million covid cases, a milestone that signifies the sheer amount of transmission that has occurred around this virus?
answer: The world recorded **100 million confirmed COVID-19 cases on January 26, 2021** (with some reports marking the milestone on January 27 because of time-zone and reporting differences).
